rotation.title: The Great Bubble Barrier
rotation.blurb: A curtain of bubbles across a canal lifts plastic to the surface and guides it into a catch system, while boats and fish pass freely. Their FAQ cites an 86 percent catch rate for floating plastic (company figure).
rotation.imageAlt: Amsterdam canal at sunrise, a frame from the Saving Planets video

rotation.title: Life Terra
rotation.blurb: Citizens plant and track trees across more than 30 European countries. Life Terra and its partners have planted more than 36 million trees as of May 2026 (company figure).
rotation.imageAlt: Sunlit forest with deer, a frame from the Saving Planets video

rotation.title: GRACE-FO (NASA / Germany)
rotation.blurb: Twin US-German satellites weigh Earth's water by measuring gravity, tracking groundwater, ice and sea level since 2018 (NASA).
rotation.imageAlt: Satellite flying above Earth, a frame from the Saving Planets video

rotation.title: Artemis II
rotation.blurb: Four astronauts flew around the Moon in April 2026 and reached 252,756 miles from Earth, the farthest humans have ever traveled (NASA).
rotation.imageAlt: Rocket lifting off at night, a frame from the Saving Planets video
